subject: Post-call: EdgeCloud functionality proof plan & prioritized tests
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Serrano <alex@edgecloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 15:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: EdgeCloud functionality proof plan & prioritized tests

Alex — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and my proposed next steps so we can get you a focused PoC without wasting cycles.

Call highlights (what you said):
- Primary evaluation areas: function/tool calling (type-safe schemas), structured JSON outputs for downstream parsing, and low-latency streaming for UI responsiveness.
- Success criteria: reliable function calls (>=95% match to schema), streaming first-token latency < 300ms in our hosted sandbox, and end-to-end cost estimates for a 1M token monthly workload.
- Constraints: data residency preference (US-west), and procurement needs an NDA + short SOW before sandbox access.

Proposed prioritized test plan (short):
1) Tool / Function-calling roundtrip (High priority) — run a 3-step orchestrated workflow where Redwood calls an EdgeCloud webhook, returns a typed JSON object, and the client validates schema + error/retry behavior. Measure correctness, failure modes, and retry latency.
2) Structured streaming (Medium priority) — stream partial JSON patches for progressive rendering in your UI; validate that incremental updates remain parseable and re-assemble to the same object as final output. Target: first-token < 300ms, steady-state throughput.
3) Multi-turn context & cache warm (Medium) — simulate 20 concurrent sessions with KV/cache warm to assess latency SLOs and token costs under realistic session distributions.

What we will deliver:
- A hosted sandbox API key scoped to this PoC, region: us-west.
- A prepared test matrix and scripts (attached).
- Short SOW + NDA to satisfy procurement (I can share a one-page SOW).

Ask from you: confirm the top-2 tests you want prioritized and whether the engineering webhook for tool-calls should live behind your staging auth or if we should put a temporary test endpoint. Also confirm timeline you prefer (you mentioned week of 12/13).

Attachments: redwood-tool-calling-test-matrix.xlsx (test cases + pass/fail thresholds)

Thanks — I'll loop Marissa and Ben in to own the test execution and SOW.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 415-555-0124

From: Alex Serrano <alex@edgecloud.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@edgecloud.com>, EdgeCloud Engineering <eng-team@edgecloud.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: EdgeCloud functionality proof plan & prioritized tests

On Tue, 8 Dec 2026 at 15:15 Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and my proposed next steps so we can get you a focused PoC without wasting cycles.

Thanks Vivek — that's helpful and aligns with what the team needs. A few quick clarifications before we lock schedule: 
- For the tool-calling flow, can Redwood support webhooks that return 202 + async callback semantics? We want to test both synchronous and async reply modes.
- For structured streaming, will you provide examples of how you handle partial JSON (e.g., JSON Patch vs newline-delimited JSON)? Our front-end prefers incremental JSON patches if possible.

Procurement — Alex here from EdgeCloud. We'll need the NDA + SOW before any sandbox API keys are issued. Please flag if there are standard terms you need changed.

We can start the PoC the week of 12/13. Prefer kickoff 12/14 afternoon PT.

Also, can you send a minimal sample dataset (anonymized) for the multi-turn cache test so our engs can reproduce expected token distributions?

Appreciate it — Alex.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Serrano <alex@edgecloud.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: EdgeCloud functionality proof plan & prioritized tests

Alex / team — looping in the test owners and attaching the detailed matrix. See the attached test plan; short notes below: 
- Test matrix includes: exact API calls, expected schema, error-injection scenarios (timeout, 5xx, invalid JSON), and pass thresholds (schema match >=95%, streaming reassembly exact match).
- Webhook modes: we support sync 200, sync 202 + callback, and async callback with idempotency keys. We will include both modes in the tool-calling tests.
- Streaming formats: we'll run two variants — newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) and JSON Patch (RFC 6902). We'll capture and timestamp first-token latency and per-chunk byte overhead.
- Metrics we'll capture: first-token latency, median per-chunk latency, token consumption, success/error rates, and resource utilization (GPU memory).

Attachments included: redwood-tool-calling-test-matrix.xlsx; PoA/NDA draft attached for procurement (poa-non-disclosure.pdf).

Ben — can you provision the hosted sandbox key (us-west) and a short-lived dedicated test instance for the cache-warm test? Prefer the sandbox by EOD 12/11 so Alex's team can start onboarding.

Vivek — I'll prepare the automation scripts and a short checklist we can send to EdgeCloud engs.

— Marissa Cole
Sr. Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Alex Serrano <alex@edgecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2026 10:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call: EdgeCloud functionality proof plan & prioritized tests

Thanks Marissa — that looks thorough. Procurement (cc'd) will review the NDA and the one-page SOW and circle back with any redlines by EOD 12/10.

Confirming priorities: 1) Tool-calling with async callback + retry behavior, 2) Structured streaming using JSON Patch. We'll share a sanitized sample dataset by 12/11 for the cache-warm test.

For kickoff, 12/14 2:00 PM PT works for our engineers. If you can send a calendar invite and the sandbox API key ahead of time (sandbox keys are ok behind a short-lived IP allowlist), we will be ready. Also please include your monitoring dashboard link so we can follow metrics during the run.

We look forward to the PoC.

— Alex Serrano
Senior Product Manager | EdgeCloud
alex@edgecloud.com
